::: {#def-conservative-confidence-interval}
#### Conservative confidence interval

A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ [confidence interval](#def-confidence-interval) $\cintf{X}$ is **conservative**
when its [coverage probability](#def-coverage-probability) is at least $1 - \siglevel$
for every possible value of $\param$ and larger than $1 - \siglevel$
for some possible value of $\param$.
:::
